## Context

The lemma `mm_pos_psi_eq` proves that `mm_pos (psi i w) = mm_pos w`. The proof is complete except for the case where `i = mm_pos w`. In this case, `psi` replaces `drop j w` (the window at position j = mm_pos w) with `rank_shift_seq(drop j w)`, which flips the head from one extremum to the other.

## The specific admit

At line ~922 in psi.v, inside `mm_pos_psi_eq`, there's:
```
  - (* i = j: rank_shift flips the extremum *)
    subst i.
    admit.
```

The goal at this point is:
```
nth 0 (psi j w) j = minv \/ nth 0 (psi j w) j = maxv
```

where:
- `j = mm_pos w`
- `minv = foldr minn (head 0 w) (behead w)` (global min)
- `maxv = foldr maxn (head 0 w) (behead w)` (global max)
- `Huniq : uniq w`, `Hws : 1 < window_size j w`, `Hiw : j < size w`
- `Hnth_w : nth 0 w j = minv \/ nth 0 w j = maxv` (from `nth_w_mm_pos`)

## Strategy for the i=j case

When `i = j = mm_pos w`:
1. `window_size j w = size w - j` (from `window_size_cons` with i = j = mm_pos)
2. `window_at j w = drop j w` (since `take (size w - j) (drop j w) = drop j w`)
3. `psi j w = take j w ++ rank_shift_seq(drop j w)` (+ empty drop)
4. `nth 0 (psi j w) j = head 0 (rank_shift_seq(drop j w))` (head of the rank-shifted window)
5. If `nth 0 w j = minv`: head of drop j w is min of drop j w (which equals minv, proved by `min_val_drop`). By `rank_shift_head_min_to_max`: new head = max of drop j w. And max of drop j w = maxv (by `max_val_drop`). So `nth 0 (psi j w) j = maxv`. ✓
6. If `nth 0 w j = maxv`: symmetric. New head = minv. ✓

## Available lemmas

Already proved in psi.v:
- `rank_shift_head_min_to_max L : uniq L -> 1 < size L -> head 0 L = nth 0 (sort leq L) 0 -> head 0 (rank_shift_seq L) = nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1`
- `rank_shift_head_max_to_min L : uniq L -> 1 < size L -> head 0 L = nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1 -> head 0 (rank_shift_seq L) = nth 0 (sort leq L) 0`
- `min_val_drop j w : w <> [::] -> foldr minn ... ∉ take j w -> j < size w -> min of (drop j w) = min of w`
- `max_val_drop j w : ...` (symmetric)
- `notin_take_mm w : w <> [::] -> minv ∉ take j w ∧ maxv ∉ take j w`
- `window_size_cons`, `window_at_cons`, `psi_id_oor`, `psi_id_trivial`
- `uniq_rank_shift_seq`, `size_rank_shift_seq`, `sort_rank_shift_seq`
- `nth_w_mm_pos w : w <> [::] -> nth 0 w (mm_pos w) = minv \/ maxv`

## Key steps to formalize

1. Show `window_at j w = drop j w` when j = mm_pos w
2. Show `nth 0 (psi j w) j = head 0 (rank_shift_seq (drop j w))`
3. Use min_val_drop/max_val_drop to relate min/max of drop j w to global min/max
4. Use rank_shift_head_min_to_max / max_to_min to get the new head
5. Conclude nth is an extremum

The proof should be ~20–30 LOC. Focus on this single admit — don't modify any other part of the file.
